title: Describing Your Birthday
credits: Faith Pirlo wrote this lesson for VOA Learning English.

sentences.en: Today, on Everyday Grammar, we will learn to describe our birthdays.
sentences.zh: 如今，在"日常语法"节目中，我们将学习如何描述自己的生日。

sentences.en: When people ask us the question “When is your birthday?” we can answer a few different ways.
sentences.zh: 当有人问我们"你的生日是什么时候？"时，我们可以用几种不同的方式回答。

sentences.en: We can use the season (spring, summer, autumn/fall, or winter), the month, or the day.
sentences.zh: 我们可以用季节（春、夏、秋或冬）、月份，或者日期。

sentences.en: My birthday is in the summer.
sentences.zh: 我的生日在夏天。

sentences.en: Her father’s birthday is in March.
sentences.zh: 她父亲的生日在三月。

sentences.en: Last Sunday was her birthday.
sentences.zh: 上周日是她生日。

sentences.en: His birthday is the 4th of May.
sentences.zh: 他的生日是五月四日。

sentences.en: Remember that word “birthday” is different from “birthdate.”
sentences.zh: 请记住，"birthday"这个词与"birthdate"不同。

sentences.en: “Birthdate” is the exact date, like December, 7th, 1997.
sentences.zh: "birthdate"指的是确切的日期，比如1997年12月7日。

sentences.en: The word “birthday” can be the date, or you can answer more generally.
sentences.zh: "birthday"这个词可以指日期，你也可以更笼统地回答。

sentences.en: For example,
sentences.zh: 例如，

sentences.en: My niece’s birthday is in August.
sentences.zh: 我侄女的生日在八月。

sentences.en: Her birthdate is August 3rd.
sentences.zh: 她的出生日期是八月三日。

sentences.en: When we want to say how old we are, we can use the present or future verb tenses depending on when our birthdays are.
sentences.zh: 当我们想说自己的年龄时，可以根据生日的时间使用现在时或将来时。

sentences.en: We can use the past tense with the verb “turn.”
sentences.zh: 我们可以用过去时配合动词"turn"。

sentences.en: If we are talking about a future birthday, say next year or in a few months, we can answer the question of “How old will you be?” with:
sentences.zh: 如果我们在谈论未来的生日，比如明年或在几个月后，我们可以这样回答"你将多大年纪？"这个问题：

sentences.en: I will be + (age). Or…
sentences.zh: 我将是+（年龄）。或者……

sentences.en: I’ll be + (number) years old.
sentences.zh: 我将是+（数字）岁。

sentences.en: In 2023, I will be 36 years old.
sentences.zh: 到2023年，我将满36岁。

sentences.en: On your birthday, you can use the present tense.
sentences.zh: 在你的生日那天，你可以使用现在时。

sentences.en: Deborah is 55 today.
sentences.zh: 今天 Deborah 五十五岁了。

sentences.en: For the past tense, we can use the structure of the verb “be” + age (years old), but we generally use it to talk about past ages in reference to something else.
sentences.zh: 表示过去时，我们可以使用动词"be"+年龄（岁）的结构，但通常用它来参照其他事情谈论过去的年龄。

sentences.en: We can also use the verb “turn” to talk about how old we are.
sentences.zh: 我们也可以使用动词"turn"来谈论我们的年龄。

sentences.en: In this way “turn” means to reach or pass a certain age.
sentences.zh: 这样一来，"turn"的意思是达到或经过某个特定年龄。

sentences.en: Therefore, we can use the past tense with “turn” for talking about birthdays. For example:
sentences.zh: 因此，我们可以用"turn"的过去时来谈论生日。例如：

sentences.en: I turned 35 this year.
sentences.zh: 我今年满35岁了。

sentences.en: This means that my birthday was in the past.
sentences.zh: 这意味着我的生日已经过去。

sentences.en: I am still considered to be 35 years old after my birthday.
sentences.zh: 生日过后，我仍被视为35岁。

sentences.en: In the present tense, we can use “turn” to say that a birthday is “today.” As in,
sentences.zh: 在现在时中，我们可以用"turn"来说明生日就在"今天"。例如：

sentences.en: Brad turns 60 today.
sentences.zh: Brad 今天满60岁了。

sentences.en: And to express a future birthday, we can use the same form, the present tense.
sentences.zh: 而表达未来的生日时，我们可以使用同样的形式，即现在时。

sentences.en: Kristen turns 41 this year.
sentences.zh: Kristen 今年满41岁了。

sentences.en: This means that sometime this year (the near future), Kristen will be 41 years old.
sentences.zh: 这意味着今年（不久的将来）的某个时候，Kristen 将会满41岁。

sentences.en: We can use the modal verb of “will” with “turn” to express a future birthday.
sentences.zh: 我们可以用情态动词"will"与"turn"连用来表达未来的生日。

sentences.en: I will turn 36 next year.
sentences.zh: 我明年满36岁了。

sentences.en: When talking about making plans for a birthday, someone may ask you: “What do you want to do for your birthday?”
sentences.zh: 在谈论为生日做计划时，有人可能会问你："你想为你的生日做些什么？"

sentences.en: You can answer with ideas of plans that you would like to do.
sentences.zh: 你可以说出你想要做的计划想法来回答。

sentences.en: You can use the expressions:
sentences.zh: 你可以使用这些表达：

sentences.en: “I want to…” or “I would like to…” to be more polite.
sentences.zh: 用"我想……"或"我想要……"会更礼貌。

sentences.en: You can even use the expression “I + be going to” if you have already made the plans, yourself.
sentences.zh: 如果你已经自己做好了计划，甚至可以使用"我+be going to"这个表达。

sentences.en: She wants to go to a French restaurant for her birthday.
sentences.zh: 她想在生日那天去一家法国餐厅。

sentences.en: I’m going to celebrate with my friends later.
sentences.zh: 我稍后会和朋友们一起庆祝。

sentences.en: If your birthday has already past, someone may ask you,
sentences.zh: 如果你的生日已经过去，有人可能会问你，

sentences.en: “How was your birthday?”
sentences.zh: “你生日过得怎么样？”

sentences.en: You can answer by describing your birthday with an adjective.
sentences.zh: 你可以用一个形容词来描述你的生日。

sentences.en: My birthday party was wonderful.
sentences.zh: 我的生日派对了不起。

sentences.en: Then they may ask you:
sentences.zh: 然后他们可能会问你：

sentences.en: “What did you do for your birthday?”
sentences.zh: “你生日做了什么？”

sentences.en: You can answer in the past tense:
sentences.zh: 你可以用过去时来回答：

sentences.en: For my birthday this year, we went to an amusement park.
sentences.zh: 今年生日那天，我们去了游乐园。

sentences.en: If someone wants to get you a gift for your birthday they may ask you:
sentences.zh: 如果有人想送你一份生日礼物，他们可能会问你：

sentences.en: “What do you want for your birthday?”
sentences.zh: “你想要什么生日礼物？”

sentences.en: “What do you want on your birthday?”
sentences.zh: “你生日想要什么？”

sentences.en: If you want something for your birthday that means a gift, generally.
sentences.zh: 如果你想得到某样生日礼物，通常指的是礼物。

sentences.en: If you want something on your birthday that could be a party or to make some type of plans to celebrate on the actual date.
sentences.zh: 如果你在生日那天想要做某事，那可能是指举办派对或在当天制定某种庆祝计划。

sentences.en: On my birthday next year, I would like to go to the countryside.
sentences.zh: 明年生日那天，我想去乡下。

sentences.en: Please don’t buy me anything for my birthday.
sentences.zh: 请不要给我买任何生日礼物。

sentences.en: After your birthday, people may ask what you received as a gift for your birthday:
sentences.zh: 你生日过后，人们可能会问你收到了什么生日礼物：

sentences.en: “What did you get for your birthday?”
sentences.zh: “你生日收到了什么礼物？”

sentences.en: “What do you get on your birthday?”
sentences.zh: “你生日得到了什么？”

sentences.en: You could say that you got or received something.
sentences.zh: 你可以说"你得到或收到了某样东西"。

sentences.en: I got a cat for my birthday.
sentences.zh: 我生日时收到了一只猫。

sentences.en: Or you could say what you got and who gave it to you.
sentences.zh: 或者你可以说你得到了什么，以及是谁送给你的。

sentences.en: Here is how you might tell about another’s birthday:
sentences.zh: 下面是你描述他人生日的方式：

sentences.en: Let’s end this report with a homework assignment.
sentences.zh: 让我们用一项家庭作业来结束这份报道。

sentences.en: In 5-8 sentences, write about your birthday this year.
sentences.zh: 用5到8句话，写一写你今年的生日。

sentences.en: Try to use ideas that you have learned about in today’s report.
sentences.zh: 尽量运用今天报道中学到的内容。

sentences.en: You can use the question headings as your guide!
sentences.zh: 你可以用问题标题作为你的写作指南！

sentences.en: Remember to use the correct verb tense depending on when your birthday is.
sentences.zh: 记得根据生日的时间使用正确的动词时态。

sentences.en: Send your writing to our email address: learningenglish@voanews.com
sentences.zh: 把你的作文发送到我们的邮箱：learningenglish@voanews.com

sentences.en: We will select one piece of writing and provide feedback and suggestions in a future report!
sentences.zh: 我们会选取一篇作文，并在未来的报道中给出反馈和建议！
